section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B source documents.
Inventing project facts (partner names, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing any Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed, or presenting budget-dependent claims as confirmed without a passing budget gate.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority by redefining phase, tier, or gate meanings.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow workflow progress when inputs are incomplete.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete, contradictory, or unvalidated, without explicitly flagging the gap.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe programme rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents when those documents are present and accessible.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The section asserts Horizon Europe regulatory claims without any Tier 1 source reference in traceability_footer.primary_sources (which contains only Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 paths — no docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/ path). Regulatory claims include: (1) sub-section 1.4 — 'a full-time parenting career break of just over 34 months ... is declared in Part A and, under MSCA rules, does not count against the research-experience ceiling'; and (2) sub-section 1.3 — 'the placement IP allocation (results vesting in HUN-REN ATK as beneficiary under the grant-agreement default ...)' / 'Ownership of placement results follows the grant agreement default'. These MSCA eligibility and Model-Grant-Agreement default provisions are grounded in Tier 3 sources (capabilities.json, working_assumptions.json) rather than a Tier 1 normative reference.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Producing outputs in Tier 5 that are not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.
